newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: JR Garments changes name after conversion.
newsitem.headline: JR Garments changes name after conversion.

text.p: JR Garments Corp said on Monday its shareholders approved a change in its name with the firm's conversion into a holding company.
The firm said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange its shareholders had approved the change in its business name to Zeus Holdings Inc.
The company also disclosed its shareholders approved the disposition of "all or substantially" its assets.
It also said the shareholders approved the conversion of the advances of PERF Realty Corp and Asian Appraisal Holdings Inc of 20 million pesos and five million, respectively in the firm into equity.
